description:
Tales of a Wanderer is a journey of self-identity — through adventure, heartbreak, and searching. 

This album is about finding a voice — not only musically, but also as a person. Over the past three years, I have been weaving together a multitude of influences, old and new, in search of a sound. Much of the final decisions were done alone, learning to trust my instincts and listen inwardly. What has emerged is an eclectic collection of music that feels true to who I am in this moment, even as I sense it already belongs to a past version of myself.

At the same time, this record is very much a collaboration. To the many people that have worked on this album, shaped and inspired me: thank you. First and foremost, thank you to the band for their commitment to the music and their inspiring performances. Thank you to Chris, Jim, Josh, and Kevin for pushing the sound of the album; to my parents for their constant support; to Lucy-Anne for her endless encouragement and exchange of ideas; to Marielle, Cécile and Lucas for making everything look so beautiful and to Mariana for making this dream into a reality. 

Thank you for listening. 

- Julien
credits:
